BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    slug varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_key varchar(255),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track_i18n (
    track_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES track(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (track_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_level (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    slug varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_key varchar(255),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_level_i18n (
    level_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_level(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (level_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_group (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    slug varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_key varchar(255),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_group_i18n (
    group_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_group(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track_level (
    track_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES track(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    level_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_level(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (track_id, level_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS level_course_group (
    level_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_level(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    group_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_group(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (level_id, group_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_group_course (
    group_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_group(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id, course_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS track_level_track_order_unique_idx
    ON track_level (track_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS level_course_group_level_order_unique_idx
    ON level_course_group (level_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS course_group_course_group_order_unique_idx
    ON course_group_course (group_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS track_source_key_unique_idx
    ON track (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS course_level_source_key_unique_idx
    ON course_level (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS course_group_source_key_unique_idx
    ON course_group (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_track_level_level_id
    ON track_level (level_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_level_course_group_group_id
    ON level_course_group (group_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_group_course_course_id
    ON course_group_course (course_id);

COMMIT;
